tool_input.prompt: You are the L2 probe agent. Launch exactly one subagent of your own using the Task tool with subagent_type general-purpose, description: probe-L3, and prompt: You are the L3 probe agent. Use no tools. Reply with exactly LEVEL3-OK and nothing else. After the L3 subagent finishes, reply with exactly: L2-REPORT: followed by the verbatim final message you received from it, or the verbatim error text if the launch was refused. Use no other tools.
